Welcome to a modern apartment in Bjerkaker – a quiet area not far from Tromsø city centre. Here you live with a short distance to nature, the sea, and city life. The apartment is perfect for couples, families and friends who want a great stay in Tromsø. The apartment is on the 2nd floor with an elevator, private parking, and a balcony. From the accommodation, it is a 25-minute walk to the city center and only 10 minutes to popular Telegrafbukta. The bus stop right outside the building makes it easy to get to the city center in 5 minutes by bus.

The space
The apartment is modern, bright and spacious, and has everything you need for a comfortable stay – whether you visit Tromsø to experience the northern lights in the winter or the midnight sun and nature in the summer.

✦ 2 bedrooms
✦ Space for up to 6 guests
✦ Balcony
✦ Free parking
✦ Elevator
✦ Fully equipped kitchen
✦ Washing machine and tumble dryer
✦ Smart-TV
✦ Smart lighting
✦ WiFi
✦ Bed linens and towels included

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS
Bedroom 1: 180 cm double bed with room for 2 people. Extra guest bed for 1 person if needed.
Bedroom 2: 150 cm double bed that sleeps 2. Extra guest bed for 1 person if needed.

BATHROOM.
Heating cables | Washing machine | Dryer | Hair dryer | Shower soap | Shampoo

KITCHEN FACILITIES
Fully equipped kitchen | Fridge and freezer | Dishwasher | Stove and oven | Coffee maker | Electric kettle

LOCATION
The apartment is located in Bjerkaker, in a quiet area with a short distance to the sea and nature. You have a grocery store, pharmacy, hairdresser, and gym nearby.
🏖️ Approximately 10 min. walk to Telegrafbukta
🚶🏼‍♂️‍➡️Approx. 25 min walk to Tromsø city centre
🚌 Approx. 5 min by bus to the city center. Bus stop right outside the building
✈️ Approx. 12 min by taxi from Tromsø Airport
🏕️Short distance to the lake and nice hiking opportunities

Guest access
You have the entire apartment to yourselves during the whole stay. There is easy access to the building via the main entrance, and an elevator can be used to reach the 2nd floor. Self-check in with code lock.

Other things to note
The apartment is well suited for both short and longer stays and is a nice starting point for experiencing Tromsø and the surrounding areas. In winter, the location is great for those who want to experience the northern lights, while summer guests can enjoy bright evenings, hiking opportunities, and the proximity to Telegrafbukta.

RECOMMENDATIONS FOR YOUR TRIP TO TROMSØ
🚌 The SVIPPER app is used for planning public transport trips and purchasing bus tickets and express boat tickets
P️ For payment of parking in the city center, the EasyPark app must be used. With it, it's easy to get an overview of parking options.
